gaps.sentence: The ___ majority voted against the proposal.
gaps.explanation: 'An overwhelming majority' = far more than half.

gaps.sentence: Tax is calculated on your total annual ___.
gaps.hint: all the money you receive from every source
gaps.explanation: 'Income' is all the money you receive from work, investments, rent and so on during a period.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't ___ what he was saying because of the noise.
gaps.explanation: 'Hear' means to receive sound; 'listen' means to pay attention deliberately and needs 'to'.

gaps.sentence: He ___ on the sofa all afternoon yesterday.
gaps.explanation: 'Lay' is the past of 'lie' (recline): he lay on the sofa. 'Laid' would need an object.

gaps.sentence: Factory workers are paid ___ at the end of each week.
gaps.hint: pay for manual work, usually weekly
gaps.explanation: 'Wages' are paid weekly, often in cash, for manual or unskilled work; salaries are monthly.

gaps.sentence: The government plans to ___ taxes next year.
gaps.hint: the verb takes an object: taxes
gaps.explanation: 'Raise' means to lift or increase something (takes an object); 'rise' means to go up (no object).

gaps.sentence: We had lunch, and ___ we went for a walk.
gaps.explanation: 'Then' means next or after that; 'than' is used in comparisons.

gaps.sentence: The comedian was so ___ that everyone cried with laughter.
gaps.explanation: 'Funny' is an adjective describing something that makes you laugh; 'fun' describes enjoyable experiences.
